desktop.title: Alex - AI Recruiter for Hiring Great People | Alex AI

headings.text: Free your team to hire at their best, at any scale. Alex is the AI recruiter that automates the busywork and creates space for your recruiters to build candidate relationships, partner with hiring managers, and win top talent.

What we loved most about Alex was the people who were willing to grow and scale with us, willing to configure and build within our applicant tracking system. Where we started and where we are now is night and day.

Traditionally in recruitment, there is a limit on the number of candidates that a recruiter can talk to in a day. Alex is a game changer, with every interested candidate being considered for the role.

Alex functions like a supercharged recruiting associate: it asks smart questions, surfaces key insights, and dramatically speeds up our screening process. Our recruiters focus on deeper conversations and higher-value work.
Alex even identified two amazing candidates that our professors did not initially shortlist because their CVs were not well aligned with the advertisement. We ended up moving forward with both.
